title: KestrelCare Benefits Schedule: Rental, Towing and Trip Interruption Amounts
content:
KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts reimburse rental, towing and trip interruption costs that accompany a covered repair, within the amounts below for each coverage level. A level showing 0 for a benefit does not include it.

| Coverage level | Rental per day (USD) | Rental maximum days per repair visit | Towing per covered breakdown (USD, maximum) |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 0.00 | 0 | 100.00 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 35.00 | 3 | 100.00 |
| KestrelCare Silver | 40.00 | 5 | 100.00 |
| KestrelCare Gold | 45.00 | 5 | 150.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 50.00 | 7 | 150.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 60.00 | 10 | 200.00 |

| Coverage level | Trip interruption per day, lodging and meals (USD) | Trip interruption maximum days per breakdown | Trip interruption minimum distance from the holder's residential address (miles) | Receipts due (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 0.00 | 0 | 100 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 0.00 | 0 | 100 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Silver | 75.00 | 3 | 100 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Gold | 100.00 | 3 | 100 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 100.00 | 5 | 100 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 150.00 | 5 | 100 | 30 |

## What each column means

- **Rental per day** is paid while a covered repair keeps the vehicle overnight; **rental maximum days** is the most rental days paid on one covered repair visit.
- **Towing** is the most reimbursed for towing on one covered breakdown.
- **Trip interruption** pays lodging and meals per day when a covered breakdown occurs far from home, up to the maximum days per breakdown, and only at or beyond the minimum distance from the holder's residential address.
- **Receipts due** is the number of calendar days, after the repair is completed, within which rental, towing or trip receipts must be submitted.

## Questions on the schedule

**Does KestrelCare Powertrain include rental?** No. Its rental per day and rental maximum days are both 0; it includes towing up to 100.00 USD.

**Which levels include trip interruption?** KestrelCare Silver, KestrelCare Gold, KestrelCare Platinum and KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary. KestrelCare Powertrain and KestrelCare Powertrain Plus show 0.

**Is a breakdown exactly 100 miles from home far enough?** Yes. The distance is a minimum, so 100 miles meets it; 99 miles does not.
